articles.summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit”) (NYSE: PRSU) today reported record third quarter 2026 results and reaffirmed the midpoint of its prior full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range. “Our record third quarter results reflect exceptional execution from our team during a dynamic peak season,” said David Barry, Pursuit president and chief executive officer. “With our strong results and continued demand for unforgettable experiences in iconic destinations, we are on track to deliver full year growth in line with our prior guidance range, and we remain well positioned to advance our growth pipeline and create long-term shareholder value.” Key Highlights Delivered record third quarter results, supported by Pursuit’s relentless focus on extraordinary guest experiences, disciplined revenue and cost management and investments to scale the business Reaffirmed $133 million midpoint guidance for full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA, representing 14% year-over-year growth, while
articles.title: Pursuit Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results and Reaffirms Full Year Adjusted EBITDA Guidance Midpoint
